title: Finch Circle Gold and Platinum Rush Fee Waiver Forms — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
For a rush fee on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the Finch Circle rush fee waiver takes exactly one of three forms, set by the customer's Finch Circle Loyalty Program membership and by whether the ticket names a purchase record of the member.

Finch Circle Gold and Finch Circle Platinum are the tiers whose qualifying spend threshold is 1200.00 USD or more and below 5000.00 USD.

| Customer | Ticket | Form | What the form waives |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active Finch Circle Gold or Platinum member | names the member's own Marlowe & Finch purchase record | co-pay form | the rush fee standing less the member rush co-pay |
| Active Finch Circle Gold or Platinum member | names no purchase record of the member | per-operation form | 8.00 USD for each operation charge, at most the rush fee standing |
| Anyone else | any | standard method | the whole rush fee for a member whose tier carries the waived rush alteration fee benefit; nothing for anyone else |

**Records read.** The tier and status of the customer's Finch Circle membership; whether the ticket names a Merchandise Purchases record of the member (a Marlowe & Finch purchase record in the member's own name).

## Both sides of each condition

| Membership | Purchase record of the member named | Form |
|---|---|---|
| Gold, active | yes | co-pay form |
| Gold, active | no | per-operation form |
| Platinum, active | yes | co-pay form |
| Platinum, not active | yes | standard method |
| tier with threshold below 1200.00 USD, active | yes | standard method |
| tier with threshold 5000.00 USD or more, active | no | standard method |

## Hypothetical illustration

An active Gold member brings in trousers bought at Marlowe & Finch on a ticket naming that purchase: co-pay form. The same member brings in a jacket bought elsewhere: per-operation form.
